outline:
本課程包含用於移植、非移植和體外的材料。移植的材料包含縫線、人工血管、人工心臟、人工骨頭、韌帶、藥物徐放裝置、人工皮膚、人工肝臟等。非移植的材料有醫療用衣服、繃帶、注射器材、診療用材料等。體外的材料包含透析膜、人工肺、人工導管等。
The objective of the course is to teach students about the modern bio-materials used in human medicine.  The students are expected to learn different types of biomaterials, how to analyze the physical properties and mechanical test.  Biodegradable biomaterials such as hydrogels is introduced as a drug delivery system.  Finally, techniques for surface treatment of biomedical materials are elucidated.  Two advance medical applications on 3D in vitro system and cell and gene therapy are introduced in the class.
Students are expected to attend the classes and participated in the classes.
schedule:
Introduction to Biomaterials
2 Biodegradable Polymers
3 Natural Biomaterials
4 Biodegradable Nanoparticles
5. Physical properties of materials
6. Thermal properties and Thermal analysis
7. Mechanics of Materials
8. Mechanical Testing and Fracture of Materials
9. Midterm exam (35%)
10. Mechanical properties of hydrogels and interpenetrating networks
11. Engineering hydrogels with controlled mechanical , chemical and biological properties
12. Developing methods of fabricating composite biodegradable hydrogels using IPNs
13. Engineering approaches to deliver growth factors from hydrogels
14.Drug delivery systems using polymeric hydrogel
15. Surface treatment of biomedical materials
16, 3D In Vitro Systems for Biological Application
17. Cell and Gene Therapy based on Biomaterials
18. Final case report (45%)
